items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Well I performed with the second liners underneath the leadership of Milton Batiste.

ctx.x: And what band did you play with?

Well I performed with the second liners underneath the leadership of Milton Batiste. I played with Donald Miner. I really don't know the name of his band, but he used to just get some guys together and perform. Not steady men with Donald Miner? No, uh-uh. Whenever a job would come up, he would call us up and let us know.
About how many pieces did he have?
Okay. I may have to tell. The second one. This is from. Let's see. I don't know where this is from. Like. Oh. This is just a parade. I don't know who. Who's in this. It's. It's. Uh.
Gerald Joseph on the left. Yeah.
